title: Re-Crafted 3
description: Completely refreshes the game, adding new biomes, structures, items and blocks.
body:
![Re-Crafted 3 Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c7c8e602c6713fb1923041a53cd6a58c56140ee.jpeg)



> **Are you looking for a modpack that adds a ton of new biomes, structures, items, blocks and even bosses? Then you've found what you're looking for! This modpack makes Minecraft a completely new game, while still keeping the Vanilla theme.**

----
![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/09900822abfacd07ec3aa02d273f61ce7f791ec4.png)

⭐ A Reworked World Generation Full of Biomes

⭐ 100+ New Structures

⭐ Refreshed Vanilla Structures

⭐ Artifacts

⭐ Special Weapons

⭐ Skill Tree

⭐ Custom UI

⭐ Player First and Third Person Animations

⭐ Built in Shaders

⭐ Quality of Life Features

⭐ 250+ Mods
